d12Effect
1Each target recovers from one status of your choosing: dazed · enraged · poisoned · shaken · slow · weak
2Each target suffers one of: dazed · shaken · slow · weak
3Each target recovers 40 Hit Points — 50 if you are level 30 or higher
4Each target recovers 40 Mind Points — 50 if you are level 30 or higher
5Deal 20 damage of one chosen type: air · bolt · earth · fire · ice · poison — 30 if you are level 30 or higher
6Until the end of your next turn, every source dealing one chosen type (air · bolt · earth · fire · ice · poison) deals 5 extra damage to each target
7Each target cannot perform the Guard action during their next turn
8Each target cannot perform the Spell action during their next turn
9Each target cannot perform the Skill action during their next turn
10Each target gains Resistance to one chosen type (air · bolt · earth · fire · ice · poison) until the end of your next turn
11Each target treats one chosen Attribute (Dexterity · Insight · Might · Willpower) as one die size higher, to a maximum of d12, until the end of your next turn
12During each target's next turn, all damage they deal becomes one chosen type (air · bolt · earth · fire · ice · poison) and its type cannot change

• A delicacy has one, two or three effects — four or six with All You Can Eat. You choose the order, and may forgo any number of them; the choice must be identical for every target.
  • Effects 5 to 12 can only be applied during conflict scenes. Effects 1 to 4 work anywhere.
  • Only one type-5 effect (damage) per delicacy. If two or more come up, choose one and forgo the rest.
  • Only one type-12 effect (damage-type change) per delicacy. Same rule.
  • Everything else is cumulative and applies in full to each target.
  • Delicacies made with Cooking are immediate and then destroyed. To make food that keeps, use Projects.
  • You may prepare delicacies outside conflict, spending the ingredients to scout an unknown pair rather than discovering it in the middle of a fight.

HEROIC SKILLS

ALL YOU CAN EAT — Requires: Cook mastery.

Once per scene, when you use Cooking, combine four ingredients into one delicacy, ignoring the normal limit of three. Everything else follows the normal rules.
